label: Moloco Ads
terms_note: 'If you don't already have an account with us, please reach out to a Moloco representative to sign up for one' — account + workplace created by Moloco; API key created in Moloco Ads → POST /cm/v1/auth/tokens → access token; TLS 1.2+; versioned (v1.10 current; deprecation emails); rate limits + entity quota pages. Free API.

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes** (Moloco Ads API v1.10 + official MCP) Confidence: **high** — official docs read.
auth: 1. Ask a Moloco representative to create the Moloco Ads account + workplace; reset the password from the welcome email.
2. Create an API key in Moloco Ads (account settings), then `POST https://api.moloco.cloud/cm/v1/auth/tokens` with the key → access token.
3. `Authorization: Bearer` on every call; TLS 1.2+; watch deprecation emails per version.

fields.name: api_key
fields.help: Moloco Ads API key (Moloco Ads > account settings > API key; created for the ad account's workplace). Exchanged at POST https://api.moloco.cloud/cm/v1/auth/tokens {api_key} for a 16-hour bearer token, re-requested on expiry or 401.

me.note: There is no current-user endpoint in the Campaign management API; the probe is GET /cm/v1/ad-accounts (ad accounts the token's user can access in the workplace).

list_accounts.note: GET /cm/v1/ad-accounts: all ad accounts accessible to the current user on the token's workplace.

list_campaigns.note: GET /cm/v1/campaigns?ad_account_id=…&states=… (states: SUBMITTED, READY, UPCOMING, ACTIVE, PAUSED, SUSPENDED, COMPLETED; deleted campaigns are excluded). The daily budget is in raw.budget_schedule.daily_schedule.daily_budget.amount_micros (micros of the account currency), so it is not mapped to `budget`; enabling_state ENABLED|DISABLED is in raw. `page`/`limit` are not sent.

get_report.note: POST /cm/v1/analytics-overview {ad_account_id, date_range {start, end}, dimensions [DATE, CAMPAIGN_ID, CAMPAIGN_TITLE], metrics [IMPRESSIONS, CLICKS, INSTALLS, CONVERSIONS, SPEND]} answers the rows synchronously; spend is in the ad account's currency. `campaign_id` is not applied (all campaigns of the account are returned, one row per day and campaign).

not_offered.update_budget: Budgets live in campaign.budget_schedule.daily_schedule.daily_budget as {currency, amount_micros} (amount × 1,000,000 as an int64 string) and are changed with PUT /cm/v1/campaigns/{campaign_id} taking the whole dspCampaign object (https://developer.moloco.cloud/reference/dspapi_updatecampaign-1); the runtime can neither scale daily_budget to micros nor send a read-modify-write of the full campaign.
not_offered.pause_resume: Pausing sets campaign.enabling_state DISABLED/ENABLED (https://developer.moloco.cloud/docs/campaign-management-api), but the only write is PUT /cm/v1/campaigns/{campaign_id} with the whole dspCampaign object as body (https://developer.moloco.cloud/reference/dspapi_updatecampaign-1); partial updates are not documented, so a body with only enabling_state could reset other settings.

evidence: host api.moloco.cloud: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (Google Trust Services)
